answer: Join weight is 1/(1 + n/20), where n counts accounts registered in the same 10-minute window, so one window yields under 20 accounts' worth however large the burst, and 10,000 identities' worth takes over 500 windows, about 3.5 days. Operators named whisper, velvet and quill can only drip registrations. Weakness: time is cheap for a patient attacker, and a burst dilutes honest joiners in its window.
